items.q: How much cheaper are cached Claude tokens?
items.a: **Cached reads cost 10% of normal input** (10× cheaper). Nate reports **91M tokens saved in one day** and **300M+ in a week** with no settings changes — caching is **automatic** in Claude Code and Claude.

items.q: What mental model should you use for each turn?
items.a: Turn one **writes everything to cache**; later turns inside the TTL only process **new messages**. Wait too long, switch models, change the system prompt, or hit `/compact` → **full recache** of the stack.

items.q: What are the three layers that get cached?
items.a: **System** (instructions, tools, output style), **project** (`CLAUDE.md`, memory, rules), and **conversation** (messages/replies that grow each turn). Cache create is the one-time write; cache read is the cheap reuse.

items.q: Why does switching models wipe cache hits?
items.a: Cache keys on **content prefix**. Each model has its own cache — `/model` (or Opus plan → Sonnet execute toggles) means the next request rereads **identical history with zero hits**.

items.q: How long does the cache last on different plans?
items.a: Claude Code **subscription: 1 hour** idle; **API default: 5 minutes** (extendable to 1 hour at cost); **sub-agents: 5 minutes** on any plan. Extra-usage after weekly limit also drops subscription to **5 minutes**.

items.q: Did Anthropic secretly cut subscription TTL to 5 minutes?
items.a: Community panic was **unfounded** — confusion came from mixing **API vs Code vs sub-agent** docs. Anthropic even SEVs if Claude Code **cache hit rates** drop too low (Thariq Shihipar).

items.q: What three habits cover 95% of users?
items.a: (1) Don't pause **>1 hour** — hand off to a fresh session. (2) **Start fresh** when switching tasks (`/compact`, `/clear`, or session handoff). (3) In Claude chat, put large docs in **Projects**, not pasted into the thread.

items.q: Is `/compact` the best way to reset a long session?
items.a: Prefer **session handoff** near ~**205K tokens**: summarize → `/copy` → `/clear` → paste. It's **faster than `/compact`**, which also **breaks the cache**. Editing `CLAUDE.md` mid-session is safe until restart.
